generic_name: Norethindrone, Ethinyl Estradiol, and Ferrous Fumarate (Iron)
drug_class: Combination Oral Contraceptive with Iron Supplement
purpose: This medication is a birth control pill that helps prevent pregnancy. It contains two hormones — a progestin and an estrogen — that work together to stop you from getting pregnant. The iron tablets included in the pack help replace iron that may be lost during your period.
how_it_works: The two hormones in this pill work in a few ways to prevent pregnancy. They stop your ovaries from releasing an egg each month, thicken the mucus in your cervix so sperm can't easily get through, and thin the lining of your uterus so a fertilized egg is less likely to attach. The iron tablets at the end of the pack are not active birth control — they are just there to help keep your iron levels healthy during your period week.
common_side_effects: Some common side effects include nausea, headaches, breast tenderness or swelling, spotting or light bleeding between periods, mood changes, and decreased sex drive. These side effects often get better after the first two to three months as your body adjusts to the medication.
warnings: Do not take this medication if you smoke and are over 35 years old, as it can raise your risk of serious blood clots, heart attack, or stroke. It is not safe to use if you have a history of blood clots, certain types of migraines with aura, liver disease, uncontrolled high blood pressure, or certain cancers. This pill does NOT protect against sexually transmitted infections. Tell your doctor about all medications you take, as some drugs can make this pill less effective.
typical_dosing: You take one active hormone pill every day for 21 days, then one iron (reminder) pill every day for 7 days, making a 28-day pack. Try to take it at the same time every day to keep it working its best. When you finish one pack, start the next pack the very next day without any break.
